description:
Subscribes the authenticated user to job alerts for a specific saved job search.

**Input:**
- `job_search_id`: The job search identifier to subscribe to (required). Accepts either the job search UUID or the composite job ID returned by `jobs_search` / `jobs_details` (format: "seo_id--job_search_id").
- `delivery`: digest, fast (optional). Fast email is not available on every account and needs enough new matches for the exact saved search. Unsupported fast selection returns a validation error and keeps the existing delivery mode.
- `frequency`: Alert frequency — one of daily, weekly, monthly (optional, defaults to "weekly")

**Output:**
Returns the created or updated job alert with id, status, and frequency.
Idempotent: calling this tool for an already-subscribed search updates the existing alert without creating a duplicate. An existing active alert with the same query text, location, company and filters, and at least the same radius, is returned instead of a new one, with the requested frequency applied to it.
A user keeps one alert per query and place. When they already have an active alert for the same query and place with other filters, radius or sort, this tool changes that alert to the new search instead of adding a second one: the returned `jobAlert.id` is the existing alert, `jobSearchId` is the new search, and `message` says the alert was changed.

**Delivery:**
Digest alerts arrive together in one email, one section per query and place. Opted-in fast alerts are sent separately while the account has them: matches found overnight arrive in one morning email at the hour the user usually starts the day, and later matches follow at least 3 hours after the previous email, up to 3 emails per local day. A fast email carries only jobs found since the previous one, never a job already sent to the user, a role from the same employer sent in the last 30 days, or a job in the user's tracker. When the account no longer has fast alerts they return to the ordinary digest and retain the saved fast preference. Each section applies every filter and the sort of its saved search, the same way `jobs_search` does for that account. A job appears in the digest once, even when it matches several alerts, and no email is sent when there are no new matches. The digest follows the most frequent alert, and arrives less often when the user has not used FoundRole for a while.

delivery.description: Delivery mode: digest, fast; fast is not available on every account and needs a qualifying search

frequency.description: Alert frequency: daily, weekly, monthly (defaults to "weekly")

job_search_id.description: Job search UUID or composite job id ("seo_id--job_search_id") from jobs_search results
